title: spec(object-timeline): items describe names objectui as the item-shape owner
body:
Fixes #20283

Clause-②: no

## What changed

`ObjectTimelinePropsSchema.items` (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`) stays `z.array(z.unknown())` — no schema-shape change. Its `.describe()` no longer says "the author owns the item shape". It now names the actual owner: each element is objectui's declared timeline element, `@object-ui/types`'s `TimelineFeedItem` (`variant` absent / `vertical` / `horizontal`) or `TimelineGanttItem` (`variant: 'gantt'`), the arm this node's own `variant` selects.

`content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` was regenerated via `gen:schema && gen:docs` — never hand-edited.

`.changeset/20283-object-timeline-items-element-owner-describe.md` — `@objectstack/spec` `patch`.

## Route taken (per the card, not re-opened)

`items` keeps `z.array(z.unknown())`; the value contract stays owned by objectui. Declaring the arms here would fork a second vocabulary. `mapping` and `object-gantt.markers` hold the same VALUE posture unchanged.

## Verification record

**Premise re-measure (required before touching code).** At `.objectui-sha` `dd3f7e1be3561d63267d7162f3fc0ac52e72834d` (the pin this branch built against), `TimelineFeedItem` and `TimelineGanttItem` are declared as plain TypeScript interfaces in objectui's `packages/types/src/data-display.ts` (lines 2773 and 2834), pinned by objectui's own `packages/types/src/__tests__/timeline-item-element-6356.test.ts`. `data-display.ts` imports `ChartAxis` / `ChartType` / `I18nLabel` from `@objectstack/spec/ui` for the unrelated chart surface, but neither `TimelineFeedItem` nor `TimelineGanttItem` imports or re-declares anything from `@objectstack/spec` — the premise holds, so the route is followed as given (no fork to report).

**Four read-point re-reads**, `objectui` `ObjectTimeline.tsx` at the same pin (`git show dd3f7e1be3561d63267d7162f3fc0ac52e72834d:packages/plugin-timeline/src/ObjectTimeline.tsx`):

- `:254` — `const hasInlineItems = Array.isArray(schema.items) && schema.items.length > 0;` (loading-state seed)
- `:374` — `const fetchesForItself = !!schema.objectName && !boundData && !schema.items && !(props as any).data;` (fetch-skip gate)
- `:546` — `if (schema.items) return schema.items;` (matches the docblock's citation exactly)
- `:771` — `const hasAuthoredItems = !!schema.items;` (matches the docblock's citation exactly)

All four anchors in the existing docblock (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`, the `object-timeline` doc comment) are byte-accurate at this pin — no anchor drift, so no docblock line-number edit was needed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:spec-docblock-symbol-anchors` also confirms: 4044 anchors resolve, 0 new anchor drift.

The `variant` describe ("`gantt` needs authored `items`") still reads true beside the new `items` describe — confirmed against `ObjectTimeline.tsx:809`, `if (!hasAuthoredItems && schema.variant === 'gantt')` — left unchanged.

**Full-repo pin sweep** for the stale sentence: `grep -rl "author owns the item shape"` across the whole tree (excluding `node_modules`/`.git`) found exactly the two carriers named at dispatch — `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` and the generated `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` — both fixed here. No test pins the old describe string (`grep` for it and for `becomes a pass-through` outside these two files: zero hits), so no fixture triage was needed.

**Round 2 correction — a false refusal clause, measured and dropped.** The first cut of this describe (and the changeset) also said objectui's strict authoring face "refuses a mismatched arm and undeclared keys" for `object-timeline` itself. A seat review measured that false at the pin, and this round independently re-measured it before editing: objectui's zod authoring face (`AnyComponentSchema` / `StrictAnyComponentSchema`, `packages/types/src/zod/index.zod.ts`) is a `z.discriminatedUnion('type', …)` whose member literals — read via `git grep -n "z.literal('object-" dd3f7e1be3561d63267d7162f3fc0ac52e72834d -- packages/types/src/zod` — are `object-grid` / `object-form` / `object-view` / `object-map` / `object-tree` / `object-gantt` / `object-calendar` / `object-kanban` / `object-chart` / `object-gallery` / `object-data-table` and, separately, `timeline` — **never `object-timeline`**. To measure the actual runtime answer rather than infer it, `packages/types` was exported read-only via `git archive dd3f7e1be3561d63267d7162f3fc0ac52e72834d packages/types` into a throwaway probe run with `tsx` against this repo's own built `@objectstack/spec` (the objectui checkout itself was never built, checked out, or stashed): `StrictAnyComponentSchema.safeParse({ type: 'object-timeline', items: [{ label: 'x' }], variant: 'vertical' })` returns a single `invalid_union` issue, `"note": "No matching discriminator"`, on both the tolerant and the strict face — `object-timeline` is refused outright as an unrecognized node `type`, before any per-item judgment runs. A control on a genuine `{ type: 'timeline', … }` node reproduces the arm-selection and `unrecognized_keys` mechanism exactly (a gantt row's `label` under `variant: 'vertical'` draws a named `custom` issue; a feed item's undeclared `date` key draws `unrecognized_keys`) — that mechanism lives on the sibling `timeline` zod node (`TimelineSchema`'s `.superRefine`), which `object-timeline` types against only in TypeScript (`ObjectTimeline.tsx`'s `schema: TimelineSchema & { … }`), never at runtime for this node. The refusal clause is dropped from the describe and the changeset; nothing else about the route changed. Re-verified after the fix: `check:generated` (15/15 green), the two component/docs-facing unit test files (`component.test.ts`, `component-element-navigation-17987.test.ts` — 366 tests green), `check:doc-authoring` and `check:spec-docblock-symbol-anchors` (both green), and a fresh `dispatch-gates.mjs` reconciliation on the new commit — same 102 derived families as round 1 (the diff only edits words inside the same two describe strings), 99 run green, the same 3 `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` NOT MEASURED as round 1.
